title: Weighted constraint experiment
statement: A weighted constraint experiment over a domain $D$, a constraint template, and a variable set $V$ consists of a finite outcome space equipped with a probability law. Each outcome selects an allowed predicate and an ordered tuple of variables of the predicate's arity; repetitions in this tuple are allowed.
